== Biography ==
{{Irish Clans}}
Adam was born about 1834. He was the son of [[Glasgow-2540|Hugh Glasgow]].
<ref>Hugh's obituary names "H. Adams Glasgow" as one of his sons, that must refer to Adam.</ref>

His wife was Mary Agnes Coulter.
<ref>Several childrens' marriage and death documents name this, although I haven't yet identified a marriage record.</ref>
